description:
After a long war, peace has come. Leticia Belletium, the sole heir to the victorious kingdom of Lakia, makes a bold declaration at her coronation: “For the sake of peace in the kingdom, I swear never to marry for the rest of my life. 

However, I plan to establish a royal harem and produce a legitimate heir to carry on the royal bloodline.” After careful selection, three men were chosen: Kael Romus, from Lakia’s most powerful noble family and a childhood friend of Queen Leticia. Harkan, the knight who has served her faithfully on the battlefield. Elody Riers, a royal descendant of the defeated nation of Zamel, offered to her as a token of surrender. 

These men became Leticia’s royal consorts. Leticia couldn’t understand what was happening. “Your Majesty, it’s alright. The wetter it is here, the easier the insertion will be.” “R-Really?” “So allow me to make it even wetter. 

"You must plant your seed.” Even the one who was meant to become the kingdom’s chancellor... “No, my liege. Call me disloyal, tear out my hair—I don’t care. But trying to drive me away from your side… that I will never forgive.” Even the war hero whose title and future were guaranteed... “Your Majesty, you need to conceive, don’t you?” Even the prisoner from Zamel, who was meant to be trained and sent back... None of them seem to want to leave Leticia’s harem... for some reason.
